reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the water system in Provincia! With the new native sparse CA, ponds are more efficient, and terrain modifications like raising lips and digging ditches now seamlessly integrate with water flow. Plus, enabling wells no longer causes frame freezes. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Provincia: Enhanced Water Mechanics Update!
